summary: Twin Vee PowerCats disclosed an Amended and Restated Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated October 7, 2026, restating the July 12, 2026 deal with USFM Corporation. Via a new Texas holdco, Twin Vee and USFM will each merge into subsidiaries; Twin Vee becomes a Pubco subsidiary. Twin Vee holders receive Pubco shares equal to 7% of post-close Pubco, fully diluted, with convertible securities accelerated. No per-share price, premium, or advisor named. Watch the Nasdaq delisting mechanics and the very low 7% retained stake.
